implementation_choices.statement: Captured frames are sampled and saved to numbered JPEG files for the later encoding stage.

evidence.quote:
case "$FORMAT" in
    mp4)
        # H.264 MP4 - Good quality, widely compatible
        ffmpeg -y -framerate 30 \
            -pattern_type glob -i "$INPUT_DIR/frame_*.jpg" \
            -c:v libx264 \
            -preset medium \
            -crf 23 \
            -pix_fmt yuv420p \
            -movflags +faststart \
            "${OUTPUT_NAME}.mp4"

implementation_choices.statement: The encoding script consumes the captured frame sequence and produces a distinct H.264 MP4 representation.
